title: GUVI: Job Sequencing with Deadlines
description: Given two lists `deadlines` and `profits` of `n` jobs, where each job takes 1 unit of time and deadline `d` means it must finish on or before time `d`. Find the maximum total profit.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 1 <= deadline <= 1000
• Time: O(N log N + N * max_deadline) | Space: O(max_deadline)
starter_code:
def job_scheduling(deadlines: list[int], profits: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
explanation: Greedy choice: pick highest-paying jobs first and schedule them into the latest available slot <= deadline.
